description: Static quality regression for every shipped dv-* skill, evaluated with NoneAgent (no agent run, no live org). Each test passes a raw SKILL.md via context_document to the SkillQualityEvaluator, which scores frontmatter quality, instruction clarity, workflow design, and error handling on a 1-5 scale (threshold 3). Current (v1.9.0) tests reference the live shipped skill in the checkout; v1.6.0 tests reference frozen snapshots so quality can be compared across versions and regressions caught at PR time.
